sentences.en: I'm reluctant to let myself be known in strange company.
sentences.zh: 我不愿意在陌生人的场合露面。

sentences.en: The directors were reluctant to undertake so risky a venture.
sentences.zh: 董事会不愿意承担这么冒险的项目。

sentences.en: Too long a holiday makes one reluctant to start work again.
sentences.zh: 假期太长了，让人不愿意重新开始工作。

senses.zh: 不情愿的，勉强的,顽抗的,难处理的,厌恶的
